sources.source_role: C++ shared-library plugin implementation; not a standalone executable
source_effects: Returns TwistStamped from optimizer_.evalControl for the host controller server
Configures and controls parameter/trajectory visualization lifecycle; optional visualization can publish trajectories
Locks parameter and costmap state; delegates plan and speed-limit changes
sources.limits: The selected file initializes Optimizer, PathHandler, ParametersHandler and TrajectoryVisualizer. computeVelocityCommands locks parameter and costmap state, transforms the goal/path, calls optimizer_.evalControl and returns TwistStamped; optimizer and critic algorithm bodies are not this selected file. Visualization defaults to false here and may publish trajectories when enabled. Lifecycle callbacks activate/deactivate visualization and parameter handling; setPlan and setSpeedLimit delegate to composed objects. Complete headers, optimizer, critics, transforms, costmap, goal checker and configured Nav2 controller server are required. The source returns a command to its host; this file does not itself publish cmd_vel. Package version 1.3.14 and cached jazzy ref are declarations, not tested compatibility. CMake enables toolchain-conditional SIMD flags and links xtensor/xsimd; no architecture, rate, robot or safe stopping was verified.

sources.source_role: C++ shared-library plugin implementation; not a standalone executable
source_effects: Returns linear x and angular z TwistStamped to the host controller server
Publishes plan, lookahead-point and rotation-state diagnostic topics
Conditional collision checker throws NoValidControl; cancellation and speed-limit callbacks alter state
sources.limits: computeVelocityCommands locks parameter/costmap state, transforms the plan, selects and publishes lookahead points, calculates curvature, handles heading rotation/reversing and applies curvature, cost and goal-approach velocity constraints. Configured collision detection can throw NoValidControl through a separate collision checker; its presence is not a measured safety guarantee. The source returns TwistStamped to its host rather than publishing cmd_vel itself. It creates lifecycle publishers for received_global_plan, lookahead_point, curvature_lookahead_point and is_rotating_to_heading. Cancellation can use configured deceleration; plan/reset/speed-limit methods change internal state. CMake explicitly requests C++17. Package version 1.3.14 and cached jazzy ref are declarations, not tested compatibility. Headers, path/parameter/collision helpers, ROS graph, transforms, footprint and host server must be supplied and reviewed.

sources.source_role: C++ shared-library plugin implementation; not a standalone executable
source_effects: Returns nav_msgs::msg::Path; it does not drive a robot or publish cmd_vel
Publishes unsmoothed paths and optional expansions/footprint markers/downsampled costmaps
Registers dynamic parameter and remote global-costmap resolution callbacks; changes search/collision/smoother state
sources.limits: configure creates AStarAlgorithm<NodeHybrid>, a footprint collision checker, optional smoother/downsampler and lifecycle path/debug publishers. Defaults include DUBIN motion model, allow_unknown=true, 72 angle bins and max_planning_time=5.0 seconds; these are source settings, not measured performance or universal robot parameters. createPlan locks the costmap, converts start/goal to grid bins, requests a path using the supplied cancellation callback, returns world-frame poses and may smooth within remaining configured time. Outside-map, occupied-start and search failures raise planner exceptions. A same-cell start/goal special case returns one pose. It can publish unsmoothed_plan, optional expansions/footprint markers and downsampled costmaps. Activation adds dynamic parameter and global-costmap resolution callbacks. CMake defaults C++17 when no standard is set and links OMPL/Eigen. No search helper, motion model, task result, controller or ROS/OS compatibility was executed or verified.
